listing.name: BDS Bismarck
listing.aiSummary: Adds a massive capital ship with high armor, speed, and weapon capacity.

description:
I call it, BISMARCK.

- 1st grade armor n´ super-durable hull.

- Avesome maneuverability, speed over 200su, burn 18.

- Monstrously high flux capacity, 360° shield coverage.

- 100 fleet points, 5000 ordnance points limit (cca. 6500 with skills affection)

- Value 19 milion cr.

-17500 cargo, 5000 fuel

-Single flight deck

- Weapon mounts:

74 small universal

30 medium universal

17 large universal

20 medium missile

4 large missile

ENJOY

(Feel free to edit this mod as much as you like)

PS.: Version of game doesnt matter. Its like any other mods - should work in later releases.

aiDescription: Adds a single capital ship designed to replace obsolete fleets. It features 1st grade armor, high maneuverability, and extensive weapon mounts including universal and missile slots. The ship has a large cargo and fuel capacity, along with a single flight deck.
